verdict.rationale: cubic has a web review UI with a visual PR diff and file tree. You can hide test files there [cubic-docs-1], and group descriptions stay beside the diff as you scroll [cubic-docs-32], all within its dedicated web UI at cubic.dev [cubic-docs-52]. Nothing shows a desktop app or running multiple sessions side by side; local work goes through the CLI instead [cubic-docs-31]. missing for 10: a desktop application, parallel side-by-side sessions, and independent corroboration of the visual diff experience.
